name: Paytm

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Heavy - 3 DSA problems in the first round (arrays, linked list/LRU, DFS/islands)
rounds: Online coding round (45–70 min, 3 problems; C/C++/Java/Python)
Technical round with core CS fundamentals (OS, DBMS, networks) and project discussion

SDE-2.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy - some loops are DSA-first, others system-design-heavy
rounds: Online assessment (HackerRank, about 63 min: 2 coding questions + 6 MCQs)
Round 1: technical + system design + LLD (e.g. travel-booking service, ETA feature)
Round 2: high-level design (e.g. risk-management service, schema and query optimisation)
SDE-2.notes: Outcome depends heavily on the interviewer: one loop is DSA-first, another has two design-heavy rounds.
